name: pavurel-design
description: Apply all 20 design skills as required by task scope for Pavurel websites and Conference Manager interfaces, including Impeccable, Taste and focused 21st research under current repository standards.

interface.longDescription: Apply the complete reviewed design-skill catalog without separate opt-in. Each task records every skill as applied, not applicable with a scope reason, or blocked. Includes all 20 skills, supporting resources and source licenses. Existing project requirements govern; native specialists remain confined to compatible stacks. Impeccable is reference-only. Taste helpers and external research operations retain their task, tool and permission boundaries. Missing required sources or 21st search capabilities are reported explicitly.
defaultPrompt: Use pavurel-web-design to review the German and English website pages for repeated content and demo CTA placement without editing.
Use pavurel-app-design to review a Customer or Platform workflow against its current repository standards without editing.
Use 21st-design-research to search for relevant component references and return up to three source names and IDs; do not retrieve code or generate anything.
